user.title: Base Power
user.description: Base Power signs in with an emailed code or a social login, so there is no password to enter here. Sign in at https://account.basepowercompany.com/sign-in, then copy the value of the `__client` cookie for that site (DevTools → Application → Cookies) and paste it below. It is long-lived; Home Assistant uses it to mint short-lived tokens the same way the mobile app does.

reauth_confirm.title: Base Power needs signing in again
reauth_confirm.description: The stored credential is no longer accepted, which happens when the Clerk session ends or is revoked. Sign in again at https://account.basepowercompany.com/sign-in and paste a fresh `__client` cookie value.

error.invalid_auth: Base Power rejected that credential. Check it was copied whole, and that it is the `__client` cookie rather than `__session` (which expires after about a minute).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Base Power API.
error.no_locations: That credential works, but the account has no sites on it.

abort.already_configured: That site is already set up.

init.title: Base Power options
init.description: How often to poll. The mobile app refreshes every second, but only while its screen is open; Home Assistant polls continuously, so the default is 30 seconds.
